reason: Both are ocean shipping companies that own and operate fleets and earn money from charter hire and voyage freight. The cargo and vessel types differ. Pangaea carries dry bulk on ice-class Supramax, Panamax and Handymax ships. Dorian carries LPG on VLGCs only. Customers also differ. Pangaea serves steel, mining, agricultural and cement shippers. Dorian serves energy majors, traders and petrochemical firms. Pangaea also designs and runs port projects, which Dorian does not. The overlap is in the kind of service and the business model, not in the product or the buyer, so this is adjacent.
